definitions: The main body or stalk of a plant or shrub.
A long, thin part of an object, such as a wine glass or a tobacco pipe.
The root or main part of a word to which inflections are added.
The front part of a ship's hull; the bow.
examples: The flower has a woody stem.
He held the glass by its stem.
The stem of the word 'running' is 'run'.
The ship's stem cut through the waves.
